decisions.statement: Nothing here takes a rule away or turns one off, so only reads and posts go out.
A 401 or a 403 is said as the token being refused that work.
A refused call is carried out rather than tried a second time.
The status is read before the body, so a refusal carrying no JSON still says why.
A 200 carrying `success: false` is a refusal rather than an answer.
A refusal naming no reason says so rather than reading as an empty reason.
Every body Cloudflare answers is parsed before anything reads a field of it.
A body carrying no result is read, because a refusal carries none.
The zone is reached by its name, so no page states a zone's id.
Rules are read a page at a time until a short page ends them.
More rules than the paging reads is refused rather than read in part.
A call that has not answered within thirty seconds is given up on.

definition: the zone's email routing rules, read from Cloudflare and written back to it
